name: hook-desktop-notification-on-stop
description: Sends a native desktop notification when Claude Code finishes responding. Uses the Stop hook event so you get a single notification per response instead of one per tool call (which is very noisy with PostToolUse). Supports macOS (osascript) and Linux (notify-send).
